description: Cache and refresh credentials inside each individual credentials provider, so a provider used standalone gets the same refresh-ahead-of-expiration, static stability, rate-limited retry and immediate non-recoverable error behavior that the default chain already had. `SsoCredentialsProvider`, `StsAssumeRoleCredentialsProvider` and `StsWebIdentityCredentialsProvider` are now closeable; close them when you are done with them to release the cache
